title: Live at the Whisky: One Night Only
text: Live at the Whisky: One Night Only is a live album by Vince Neil, lead vocalist of heavy metal band Mötley Crüe, recorded at the Whisky a Go Go. The album includes songs originally performed by Mötley Crüe. In the album's cover art, the nightclub's name is changed to "The Whisky".

title: Respect to Mehmetçik Monument
text: The Respect to Mehmetçik Memorial (Turkish: "Mehmetçiğe Saygı Anıtı" ) is a monument in the Gallipoli peninsula, Turkey. Mehmetçik is a common name given to soldiers in a war, just like G.I..
